cases.semantics: nth-child belongs to the direct-child div segment and first-child belongs to the descendant span segment
the descendant pseudo must be evaluated inside the selected fourth direct child
the same segmented pseudo semantics apply when the left selector is a tag
ordinal 223 contains a real no-space direct-child followed by a descendant pseudo chain

legadoSemantics.implementation: AnalyzeByJSoup delegates the complete selector to Jsoup Element.select
legadoSemantics.segmentPolicy: Each compound selector segment owns its pseudo classes before descendant traversal continues.
legadoSemantics.directChildPolicy: The first segment after > must match a direct child; descendants of that direct child may be returned by the remaining selector segments.

failureCondition: The V2 direct-child helper applies findElementsBySimpleSelector to the entire right operand. Pseudos on an ancestor segment are collected globally and applied to the final descendant element, so a valid segmented selector returns empty or an incorrect node.
